content:
Overview

Banja Luka is a city in Republika Srpska with a population of 185,000. The second-largest city in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the de facto capital of Republika Srpska, known for its green boulevards, the Vrbas River, and the Kastel Fortress. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
